```{r theme plot}
diet_colors <- c(
  "Omnivore"   = "#2864A5",
  "Vegetarian" = "#9C3F90",
  "Vegan"      = "#B36B32")

element_colors <- c(
  "Plasmid"                 = "#0F4C81",
  "Prophage"                = "#765D9A",
  "Viral sequence"          = "#2D6A8A",
  "Insertion sequence"      = "#A23E48",
  "Integron"                = "#4C956C",
  "Conjugative integron"    = "#789447",
  "Direct repeat element"   = "#E0A458",
  "Inverted repeat element" = "#C46D4A",
  "Compositional outlier"   = "#6B6D76",
  "No element annotation"   = "#B8B8B8")

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey30"),
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9)))

dir.create(here("3.-Assembly_based","Results","Plots"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(here("3.-Assembly_based","Results","Tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Load data

```{r load data}
metadata <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "metadata.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  select(sample_id, diet_group)
contig_master <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "contig_master.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  left_join(metadata, by = "sample_id") %>% filter(!is.na(species))
contig_mge <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "contig_mge.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
```

# Description

```{r}
contig_elements <- contig_master %>%
  distinct(sample_id, contig_id, diet_group, genus, species, is_plasmid) %>%
  left_join(contig_mge %>% distinct(sample_id, contig_id, element_type),
            by = c("sample_id", "contig_id")) %>%
group_by(sample_id, contig_id, diet_group, genus, species) %>%
  summarise(plasmid = any(is_plasmid %in% TRUE),
            prophage = any(element_type == "prophage", na.rm = TRUE),
            direct_repeat_element = any(element_type == "direct_repeat_element",na.rm = TRUE),
            compositional_outlier = any(element_type == "compositional_outlier",na.rm = TRUE),
            inverted_repeat_element = any(element_type == "inverted_repeat_element",na.rm = TRUE),
            viral_sequence = any(element_type == "viral_sequence",na.rm = TRUE),
            insertion_sequence = any(element_type == "insertion_sequence",na.rm = TRUE),
            conjugative_integron = any(element_type == "conjugative_integron",na.rm = TRUE),
            integron = any(element_type == "integron",na.rm = TRUE),
            no_element_annotation = all(is.na(element_type) & !any(is_plasmid %in% TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop")

total_contigs <- nrow(contig_elements)
element_summary <- contig_elements %>%
  summarise(Plasmid = sum(plasmid),
            Prophage = sum(prophage),
            `Direct repeat element` = sum(direct_repeat_element),
            `Compositional outlier` = sum(compositional_outlier),
            `Inverted repeat element` = sum(inverted_repeat_element),
            `Viral sequence` = sum(viral_sequence),
            `Insertion sequence` = sum(insertion_sequence),
            `Conjugative integron` = sum(conjugative_integron),
            Integron = sum(integron),
            `No element annotation` = sum(no_element_annotation)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(),
               names_to = "element_type",
               values_to = "n_contigs") %>%
  mutate(percentage = n_contigs / total_contigs * 100) %>%
  arrange(desc(percentage))

element_summary

cat("Number of ARG-containing contigs:", total_contigs, "\n\n")

element_summary %>%
  mutate(output = paste0(element_type,
                         ": ",
                         n_contigs,
                         " contigs (",
                         round(percentage, 2),
                         "%)")) %>%
  pull(output) %>%
  cat(sep = "\n")
```


```{r element types}
plot_element_types <- element_summary %>%
  mutate(element_type = fct_reorder(element_type,
                                    percentage)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = element_type,
             y = percentage,
             fill = element_type)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72,
           colour = "black",
           linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(percentage, 1),
                               "%  (n = ",
                               scales::comma(n_contigs),
                               ")")),
            hjust = -0.08,
            size = 3.2,
            fontface = "bold") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = element_colors, name = "Mobile element") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1,
                                                    accuracy = 1),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.25))) +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = "% of total ARG-contigs") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.35, "cm"),
        legend.spacing.x = grid::unit(0.08, "cm")) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 3,
                             byrow = TRUE))

plot_element_types
```



```{r}
n_species_level <- nrow(contig_master %>% filter(!is.na(species)) %>% distinct(sample_id, contig_id))
n_distinct_species <- n_distinct(contig_master$species, na.rm = TRUE)
n_distinct_genus <- contig_master %>% filter(!is.na(species)) %>% summarize(
  n= n_distinct(contig_master$genus, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% pull(n)
cat("Number of species-level contigs:", n_species_level,"\n")
cat("Diferent species identified:", n_distinct_species,"\n")
cat("Diferent genus identified:", n_distinct_genus,"\n")
```

```{r mobilome species}
contig_species <- contig_elements %>%
  distinct(sample_id,
           contig_id,
           species,
           .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  #filter(!is.na(species)) %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(n_contigs = n(),
            n_mbe = sum(!no_element_annotation,na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(percentage_mbe = n_mbe / n_contigs * 100) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = n_contigs,
            n = 10,
            with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_contigs))

top15_species <- contig_species$species


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Count each mobile-element annotation by species
#
# The categories are counted independently because a contig
# can contain more than one type of mobile-element annotation.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

contig_species_elements <- contig_elements %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(species),
    species %in% top15_species
  ) %>%

  group_by(species) %>%

  summarise(
    Plasmid = sum(
      plasmid,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    Prophage = sum(
      prophage,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    `Viral sequence` = sum(
      viral_sequence,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    `Insertion sequence` = sum(
      insertion_sequence,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    Integron = sum(
      integron,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    `Conjugative integron` = sum(
      conjugative_integron,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    `Direct repeat element` = sum(
      direct_repeat_element,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    `Inverted repeat element` = sum(
      inverted_repeat_element,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    `Compositional outlier` = sum(
      compositional_outlier,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%

  pivot_longer(
    cols = -species,
    names_to = "element_type",
    values_to = "n_element_contigs"
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    element_type = factor(
      element_type,
      levels = names(element_colors)
    )
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Set the species order
#
# With coord_flip(), the last factor level appears at the top.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

species_levels <- contig_species %>%
  arrange(n_contigs) %>%
  pull(species)


contig_species <- contig_species %>%
  mutate(
    species = factor(species,
                     levels = species_levels))

```


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)

# ============================================================
# Prepare data
# ============================================================

species_levels <- contig_species %>%
  arrange(n_contigs) %>%
  pull(species)

contig_species_plot <- contig_species %>%
  mutate(
    species = factor(
      species,
      levels = species_levels
    )
  )

contig_species_elements_plot <- contig_species_elements %>%
  filter(
    element_type != "No element annotation",
    n_element_contigs > 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    species = factor(
      species,
      levels = species_levels
    ),
    element_type = factor(
      element_type,
      levels = names(element_colors)
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# Left side: total ARG-contigs
# ============================================================

plot_total_contigs <- ggplot(
  contig_species_plot,
  aes(
    y = species,
    x = n_contigs
  )
) +

  # Central axis
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +

  geom_col(
    width = 0.82,
    fill = "grey85",
    colour = "grey25",
    linewidth = 0.35,
    orientation = "y"
  ) +

  # Total number of contigs
  geom_text(
    aes(
      x = n_contigs,
      label = scales::comma(n_contigs)
    ),
    hjust = -0.15,
    size = 3,
    fontface = "bold",
    colour = "black"
  ) +

  # Number and percentage with any MBE annotation
  geom_col(
    aes(x = n_mbe),
    width = 0.46,
    fill = "grey55",
    colour = "grey25",
    linewidth = 0.25,
    orientation = "y"
  ) +

  # Makes bars extend towards the left
  scale_x_reverse(
    labels = scales::label_number(
      scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale()
    ),
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0, 0.16)
    )
  ) +

  scale_y_discrete(
    limits = species_levels,
    drop = FALSE,
    expand = expansion(add = 0.55)
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    clip = "off"
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Total ARG-contigs",
    y = NULL
  ) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +

  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      face = "italic",
      size = 9
    ),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),

    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),

    axis.title.x = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 9
    ),

    legend.position = "none",

    # No margin on the side touching the other plot
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 5.5,
      r = 0,
      b = 5.5,
      l = 5.5
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# Right side: mobile-element annotation counts
# ============================================================

plot_mobile_elements <- ggplot(
  contig_species_elements_plot,
  aes(
    y = species,
    x = n_element_contigs,
    fill = element_type,
    group = element_type
  )
) +

  # Central axis
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +

  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge2(
      width = 0.90,
      preserve = "single",
      padding = 0.04
    ),
    width = 0.82,
    colour = "grey20",
    linewidth = 0.15,
    orientation = "y"
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Mobile element",
    values = element_colors[
      names(element_colors) != "No element annotation"
    ],
    drop = TRUE
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_number(
      scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale()
    ),
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0, 0.12)
    )
  ) +

  scale_y_discrete(
    limits = species_levels,
    drop = FALSE,
    expand = expansion(add = 0.55)
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Mobile-element annotations",
    y = NULL
  ) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +

  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),

    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),

    axis.title.x = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 9
    ),

    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 9
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 7.5
    ),
    legend.key.size = grid::unit(
      0.3,
      "cm"
    ),
    legend.spacing.x = grid::unit(
      0.08,
      "cm"
    ),

    # No margin on the side touching the other plot
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 5.5,
      r = 5.5,
      b = 5.5,
      l = 0
    )
  ) +

  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      nrow = 2,
      byrow = TRUE,
      override.aes = list(
        colour = "grey20",
        linewidth = 0.25
      )
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# Join both sides at the central zero axis
# ============================================================

plot_contig_species_mirrored <- (
  plot_total_contigs |
    plot_mobile_elements) +
  plot_layout(
    widths = c(1, 1.35),
    guides = "collect"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )


plot_contig_species_mirrored
```

```{r}
library(viridis)


contig_gene_species <- contig_master %>%
  filter(!is.na(AMR_gene),
         AMR_gene != "",
         !is.na(species),
         species != "") %>%
  distinct(sample_id,
           contig_id,
           AMR_gene,
           species,
           genus) %>%
  rename(gene = AMR_gene)


gene_abundance <- contig_gene_species %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(n_contigs = n_distinct(interaction(sample_id,
                                               contig_id,
                                               drop = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_contigs))



```

```{r}

top15_genes <- gene_abundance %>%
  slice_max(order_by = n_contigs,
            n = 15,
            with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_contigs))

top15_gene_names <- top15_genes$gene

top15_gene_genus <- contig_gene_species %>%
  filter(gene %in% top15_gene_names) %>%
  group_by(gene, genus) %>%
  summarise(n_contigs_genus = n_distinct(interaction(sample_id,
                                                     contig_id,
                                                     drop = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop")

gene_levels <- rev(top15_gene_names)

top15_gene_genus <- top15_gene_genus %>%
  mutate(gene = factor(gene,
                       levels = gene_levels))

top15_genes <- top15_genes %>%
  mutate(gene = factor(gene,
                       levels = gene_levels))
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# ARG gene richness within species and samples
# ============================================================

# One row per sample, species and distinct ARG gene
sample_species_genes <- contig_gene_species %>%
  distinct(
    sample_id,
    species,
    genus,
    gene
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    metadata,
    by = "sample_id"
  )


# Number of distinct ARG genes carried by each species
# within each individual sample
sample_species_ARG_richness <- sample_species_genes %>%
  group_by(
    sample_id,
    diet_group,
    species,
    genus
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_distinct_ARG = n_distinct(gene),
    ARG_profile = paste(
      sort(unique(gene)),
      collapse = " + "
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ============================================================
# Rank species according to within-sample ARG gene richness
# ============================================================

species_ARG_richness_summary <- sample_species_ARG_richness %>%
  group_by(
    species,
    genus
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples = n_distinct(sample_id),
    mean_n_ARG = mean(
      n_distinct_ARG,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    median_n_ARG = median(
      n_distinct_ARG,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    maximum_n_ARG = max(
      n_distinct_ARG,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%

  # Avoid ranking species represented by only one or two samples
  filter(n_samples >= 3) %>%

  arrange(
    desc(maximum_n_ARG),
    desc(mean_n_ARG),
    desc(n_samples)
  )


# Select the 15 species with the highest within-sample
# ARG gene richness
top15_species_ARG_richness <- species_ARG_richness_summary %>%
  slice_head(n = 15)

top15_species_ARG_names <- top15_species_ARG_richness$species


# Order species for plotting
species_ARG_levels <- top15_species_ARG_richness %>%
  arrange(
    mean_n_ARG,
    maximum_n_ARG
  ) %>%
  pull(species)


sample_species_ARG_plot <- sample_species_ARG_richness %>%
  filter(
    species %in% top15_species_ARG_names
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    species = factor(
      species,
      levels = species_ARG_levels
    ),
    diet_group = factor(
      diet_group,
      levels = names(diet_colors)
    )
  )


species_ARG_labels <- top15_species_ARG_richness %>%
  mutate(
    species = factor(
      species,
      levels = species_ARG_levels
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# Plot 1: within-sample ARG gene richness by species
# ============================================================

plot_species_ARG_richness <- ggplot(
  sample_species_ARG_plot,
  aes(
    x = species,
    y = n_distinct_ARG
  )
) +

  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = NA,
    width = 0.68,
    fill = "grey90",
    colour = "grey25",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  # Each point represents one species within one sample
  geom_jitter(
    aes(fill = diet_group),
    shape = 21,
    colour = "black",
    width = 0.17,
    height = 0,
    size = 1.8,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +

  # Maximum observed value and number of samples
  geom_text(
    data = species_ARG_labels,
    aes(
      x = species,
      y = maximum_n_ARG,
      label = paste0(
        "max = ",
        maximum_n_ARG,
        "; n = ",
        n_samples
      )
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = -0.12,
    size = 2.7,
    fontface = "bold",
    colour = "black"
  ) +

  coord_flip(
    clip = "off"
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Diet group",
    values = diet_colors,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 6),
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0.03, 0.28)
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Within-sample ARG gene richness by bacterial species",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Each point represents the number of distinct ARG genes ",
      "assigned to a species within one individual sample."
    ),
    x = NULL,
    y = "Distinct ARG genes per species and sample"
  ) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +

  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      face = "italic",
      size = 8.5
    ),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 9
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 8
    )
  )


plot_species_ARG_richness


```
```{r}

# ============================================================
# ARG combinations located on the same contig
# ============================================================

# One row per contig, containing its complete combination
# of distinct ARG genes
contig_ARG_combinations <- contig_gene_species %>%
  group_by(
    sample_id,
    contig_id,
    species,
    genus
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_distinct_ARG = n_distinct(gene),
    ARG_combination = paste(
      sort(unique(gene)),
      collapse = " + "
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%

  # Keep contigs carrying at least two distinct ARG genes
  filter(n_distinct_ARG >= 2) %>%

  mutate(
    combination_size = case_when(
      n_distinct_ARG == 2 ~ "2 ARG genes",
      n_distinct_ARG == 3 ~ "3 ARG genes",
      n_distinct_ARG >= 4 ~ "≥4 ARG genes"
    ),
    combination_size = factor(
      combination_size,
      levels = c(
        "2 ARG genes",
        "3 ARG genes",
        "≥4 ARG genes"
      )
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# Global frequency of each same-contig ARG combination
# ============================================================

ARG_combination_summary <- contig_ARG_combinations %>%
  group_by(
    ARG_combination,
    n_distinct_ARG,
    combination_size
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_contigs = n(),
    n_samples = n_distinct(sample_id),
    n_species = n_distinct(species),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(n_contigs),
    desc(n_samples),
    desc(n_distinct_ARG)
  )


# Select the 20 most frequent combinations
top20_ARG_combinations <- ARG_combination_summary %>%
  filter(
    (n_distinct_ARG == 2 & n_contigs >= 3) |
    (n_distinct_ARG == 3 & n_contigs >= 2) |
    n_distinct_ARG >= 4
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    combination_label = paste0(
      stringr::str_wrap(
        ARG_combination,
        width = 50
      ),
      "\n",
      "n = ",
      n_contigs,
      " contigs: ",
      n_samples,
      " samples"
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# Count the bacteria associated with each combination
# ============================================================

ARG_combination_species <- contig_ARG_combinations %>%
  semi_join(
    top20_ARG_combinations,
    by = c(
      "ARG_combination",
      "n_distinct_ARG",
      "combination_size"
    )
  ) %>%

  group_by(
    ARG_combination,
    n_distinct_ARG,
    combination_size,
    species,
    genus
  ) %>%

  summarise(
    n_contigs = n(),
    n_samples = n_distinct(sample_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%

  left_join(
    top20_ARG_combinations %>%
      select(
        ARG_combination,
        n_distinct_ARG,
        combination_size,
        combination_label,
        total_combination_contigs = n_contigs
      ),
    by = c(
      "ARG_combination",
      "n_distinct_ARG",
      "combination_size"
    )
  )


# Order combinations by global abundance
ARG_combination_levels <- top20_ARG_combinations %>%
  arrange(
    n_distinct_ARG,
    n_contigs
  ) %>%
  pull(combination_label)


# Order species by the number of multi-ARG contigs
combination_species_levels <- ARG_combination_species %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(
    total_contigs = sum(
      n_contigs,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_contigs)) %>%
  pull(species)


ARG_combination_species <- ARG_combination_species %>%
  mutate(
    combination_label = factor(
      combination_label,
      levels = ARG_combination_levels
    ),
    species = factor(
      species,
      levels = combination_species_levels
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# Colours according to the number of genes in the combination
# ============================================================

ARG_combination_colors <- c(
  "2 ARG genes" = "#2D6A8A",
  "3 ARG genes" = "#E0A458",
  "≥4 ARG genes" = "#A23E48"
)


# ============================================================
# Plot 2: same-contig ARG combinations and bacterial species
# ============================================================

plot_contig_ARG_combinations <- ggplot(
  ARG_combination_species,
  aes(
    x = species,
    y = combination_label
  )
) +

  geom_point(
    aes(
      size = n_contigs,
      fill = combination_size
    ),
    shape = 21,
    colour = "black",
    stroke = 0.35,
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +

  facet_grid(
    combination_size ~ .,
    scales = "free_y",
    space = "free_y"
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = ARG_combination_colors,
    guide = "none",
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_size_continuous(
    name = "Number of contigs",
    range = c(2.5, 10),
    breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 4)
  ) +

  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
  ) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +

  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      face = "italic",
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 8,
      color = "black"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      face = "italic",
      size = 8.5
    ),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(
      colour = "grey90",
      linewidth = 0.3
    ),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      angle = 0,
      size = 8
    ),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    )
  )


plot_contig_ARG_combinations
```
